instructions.1: Trim the leeks and cut the white part into even pieces.
instructions.2: Wash in cold water, then boil in salted boiling water.
instructions.3: Drain, arrange on a plate and cover with the sauce; garnish with parsley and serve.
instructions.4: Or put them in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle the top with a few breadcrumbs, dot with small pieces of butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

instructions.1: Prepare the leeks, cut the white part and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Sauté the leeks in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.3: Arrange the leeks and the asag with tomatoes in a small pot or ovenproof dish and add the water.
instructions.4: Bake in a low oven or cook over low heat until done.
instructions.5: Stuffed leek mold: drain the boiled leeks, hollow out part of the center of each piece and fill with asag; arrange in a small pot or ovenproof dish, add cold water and cook over low heat or in the oven until done.
instructions.6: Leeks in tomato sauce: half-boil the cut leeks in salted boiling water; make the tomato sauce, add ¼ kg meat and cook until nearly done, then add the leeks and cook until tender.

osool-555.title: Celery Hearts in White or Cheese Sauce

osool-555-i3.name: White sauce or rumi cheese sauce

instructions.1: Trim the celery and cut the white part into even pieces; keep them in cold water with lemon juice until needed.
instructions.2: Boil in boiling water with lemon juice and salt until tender, then drain.
instructions.3: Serve hot with butter, or with buttered toast.
instructions.4: In white sauce: cut the celery lengthwise into medium pieces, arrange on a plate, cover with white sauce and garnish with parsley; or put in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake in a hot oven until browned.
instructions.5: In cheese sauce: layer the celery in an ovenproof dish with a little grated cheese between the layers, cover with cheese sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

instructions.1: Leave the taro whole, wipe it with a damp cloth and bake in a hot oven until tender.
instructions.2: Peel the cooked taro and mash it, then add the butter, milk, salt and pepper and mix well.
instructions.3: Serve with grilled liver and meats, or on its own garnished with fried eggs.

osool-557.title: Taro in Tomato Sauce and Taro Moussaka

instructions.1: Peel the taro and cut into medium-thick slices; do not wash it at all.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, fry the taro in it and lift out.
instructions.3: Cut the meat into small pieces, wash, then brown it in the ghee left from frying the taro.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the vinegar, then the taro, and stir briefly.
instructions.5: Add enough water to cover the taro, season with salt and pepper and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.6: Taro moussaka: peel the taro, cut each lengthwise into quarters and then into ½ cm thick pieces, and fry lightly; layer alternately with an onion base made with minced meat in a pot or tagine, pour over the liquid and cook until tender.

osool-558.title: Purslane: Boiled, with Oil and Lemon, or Stewed

osool-558-i3.name: French dressing (oil, lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Wash the purslane several times in cold water and pick off the leaves.
instructions.2: Boiled: boil in a little salted boiling water until tender and drain.
instructions.3: With oil and lemon: let the boiled purslane cool, chop it coarsely and add the French dressing just before serving.
instructions.4: In stock: put the coarsely chopped purslane in a pot with 1–1½ cups stock, a whole onion, 1 tablespoon butter, salt and pepper and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Stewed: make the onion base with the meat and tomatoes in the ghee, add the chopped purslane before adding any liquid and stir over low heat; add liquid as needed until nearly done, then add the rice or chickpeas and cook until tender (without dill).

osool-559.title: Okra with Chard and Garlic Paste (Khodra)

instructions.1: Wash the okra and let it dry, then trim the tops into a cone shape.
instructions.2: Half-boil the meat with the onion, skimming off the scum whenever it appears, then add the okra and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Prepare the chard: wash, remove the ribs and shred; peel the garlic and chop it finely.
instructions.4: Fry the chard briefly in the ghee, then add the garlic and stir until golden; then mash the chard very thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.5: Add the green paste to the okra and boil for 5 minutes.

instructions.1: Prepare the okra, fry it lightly in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the onion base in the remaining ghee: brown the onion, then add the meat, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates.
instructions.3: Lift the meat out of the sauce and put a layer of it in the bottom of a small pot; arrange the okra neatly on top, then put the rest of the meat in the center.
instructions.4: Fill the pot with the okra, add the onion base and close the lid tightly.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until done, and turn out onto a plate when ready to serve.
instructions.6: Okra mold with minced meat: made as above, but with the onion base made with minced meat instead of cubes.
instructions.7: Okra mold, third method: clean the okra, fry lightly and lift out; sauté the chopped onion briefly in the remaining ghee, add the cubed meat and stir, then add a little water and cook for 15 minutes; lift out the meat and arrange it in the bottom of the pot with a layer of onion, then arrange the okra, add the tomato juice and the rest of the water and cook over low heat; a sliced carrot can be added with the meat.

instructions.1: Wash the dried okra well, then boil in boiling water until tender.
instructions.2: Make the onion base (adding the chopped garlic when the onion turns golden) and cook over low heat until nearly done.
instructions.3: Add the boiled okra and cook over low heat until fully done.

instructions.1: Prepare the okra, then slice it thinly, fry in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Fry the onion in the remaining ghee until golden, then add the meat and brown it.
instructions.3: Add the liquid, season and cook until the meat is half done, then add the okra.
instructions.4: Stir well with a spoon so the okra breaks down, and cook until done; adjust the seasoning.
instructions.5: Make the taqliya with the ghee, coriander and garlic and add it to the wika.
instructions.6: Wika with spiced mince: made as above but using asag instead of cubed meat.
instructions.7: Dried okra wika: fry ⅛ kg dried okra well, then pound until fine; add 2 tablespoons ghee, ½ kg asag, 1 cup strained tomatoes, meat or poultry stock, salt, pepper and chili; cook over low heat until done, then season and add the taqliya.

osool-563-i2.name: Water, salt and lemon juice (1 tablespoon per liter)

osool-563-i4.name: French dressing, white sauce or cheese sauce

instructions.1: Wash the asparagus, then scrape the white part, working from the tip toward the stalk; remove any tough pieces, trim the ends even and wash again.
instructions.2: Keep in cold water until needed, then tie with linen string into even bundles (8 to 10 spears per bundle).
instructions.3: Bring the water to a boil with the salt and lemon juice and boil the asparagus in it.
instructions.4: Serve hot with bread and butter, or as you like.
instructions.5: With French dressing: drain the asparagus, cut into 5 cm lengths, dress with French dressing for 10 minutes, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.6: With white sauce or cheese sauce: drain the asparagus, dry with a towel and cut into 5 cm lengths; arrange in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.
instructions.7: Sautéed asparagus: cut the boiled asparagus into suitable pieces; melt the butter and gently toss the asparagus in it for a few minutes; sprinkle with salt, pepper and parsley.

osool-564.title: Fresh Fava Beans with Greens (Chard, Dill and Coriander)

instructions.1: Prepare the fava beans like green beans (wash, remove the strings and cut).
instructions.2: Wash the fresh coriander and dill, then chop.
instructions.3: Cut the meat into medium pieces and sauté in 1 tablespoon ghee.
instructions.4: Add the herbs (dill and coriander), the meat and the onions and sauté over low heat for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.5: Add the water and bring to a boil, then add the prepared beans and cook until nearly tender; add the rice.
instructions.6: Crush the garlic and coriander seed; pick and cut the chard.
instructions.7: Fry the chard in the remaining ghee, then add the garlic and coriander.
instructions.8: Crush the chard until completely smooth, add it to the cooked beans and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Fresh fava beans boiled, with oil and lemon, or stewed: made in the same ways as green beans.

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes, cut off the tops, keeping them as lids, and remove the seeds.
instructions.2: Season the tomatoes with salt and pepper and turn upside down to drain their juice.
instructions.3: Fill with the sautéed vegetables.
instructions.4: Make a bed of lettuce on a plate and arrange the tomatoes on it, each filled with a different sautéed vegetable.
instructions.5: Boiled vegetables dressed with French dressing can be used instead of sautéed vegetables.

osool-566-i5.name: Melted ghee for brushing the tomatoes

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes, cut a small piece off the top of each and remove the seeds.
instructions.2: Season the tomatoes with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Mix the cheese with the breadcrumbs and stuff the tomatoes with it.
instructions.4: Brush the outside of the tomatoes with a little melted ghee and place in a greased tray.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven for 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Butter the toasted bread, arrange it neatly on a plate and set the tomatoes on top; garnish with parsley and serve hot.

osool-567.title: Tomato Stew with Meat and Rice

instructions.1: Make the onion base using half the tomatoes: brown the onion in the ghee, then add the meat, then half the strained tomatoes and the seasoning until the ghee separates.
instructions.2: Add the rest of the strained tomatoes, a little water, salt and pepper and cook until the meat is nearly tender.
instructions.3: Wash the rice and add it to the tomatoes; lower the heat and cook until done.

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes, then cut each in half crosswise.
instructions.2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper, then with breadcrumbs, and put a small piece of butter on each half.
instructions.3: Arrange in a greased tray and bake in a hot oven for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Serve with meat dishes and roast poultry.

osool-569.title: French-Style Lamb and Spring Vegetable Stew (Torly)

instructions.1: Cut the meat into pieces and prepare the vegetables, leaving them whole.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil and add the meat, carrots and onions; season everything with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat for half an hour.
instructions.4: Add the potatoes, peas and mint, cover and cook until everything is tender.
instructions.5: Ladle into a deep dish and serve hot.

osool-570-i1.name: Mixed vegetables (potatoes, carrots, peas and cauliflower)

osool-570-i3.name: For the curry sauce: small onion

osool-570-i5.name: For the curry sauce: curry powder

osool-570-i8.name: For the curry sauce: chopped apple and lemon juice

instructions.1: Prepare the vegetables according to their kind.
instructions.2: Make the curry sauce: fry the onion in the ghee, then add the curry powder, flour and apple, then the stock gradually, stirring until it boils; add the lemon.
instructions.3: Add the meat to the sauce and simmer for half an hour, then add the vegetables.
instructions.4: Cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.5: Spoon onto a plate with the boiled rice around it.

osool-571.title: Boiled Onions in White Sauce and Braised Pearl Onions

osool-571-i5.name: For the braised onions: stock or water

instructions.1: Peel the onions and trim a little off the top and bottom.
instructions.2: Put them in cold water on the heat and boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Discard the water, replace it with fresh water and cook again until tender.
instructions.4: Drain and wrap in a towel while hot, covering them well so they do not discolor.
instructions.5: In white sauce: arrange the onions on the plate if small, or cut each in half; cover with the hot white sauce, garnish with parsley and serve.
instructions.6: Braised pearl onions: peel the small onions without trimming the tops, wash and dry them, and brown in the ghee; add a little liquid, season, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender; serve with meats.

instructions.1: Add a little salt to the onions and stir over medium heat until they absorb their liquid and turn golden, sprinkling with a very little water whenever they dry out, until fully browned; then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes and the meat and stir everything over low heat for 10 minutes, then pour in a little liquid and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Put the onions and meat into a tagine, cover and bake in the oven, removing the lid shortly before it is done so the top browns.
instructions.4: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine and serve on a plate.
instructions.5: Fried onions for garnish: peel the onions and slice into thin rings, or chop finely or coarsely, or leave small ones whole; or coat the rings in flour, dip in egg white and then flour again, or in egg and breadcrumbs; fry in very hot ghee or oil and lift onto paper.
instructions.6: Roasted onions: put the onions in their skins in a tray and roast in the oven until tender, or peel them, wrap in greased paper and cook in the oven until tender.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the onion until golden, then lightly toast the flour in it and set aside to cool.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs seasoned with salt, pepper, mint, and parsley, then add them to the cooled onion and flour mixture and mix well.
instructions.3: Prepare a pan with a little hot oil and pour in the mixture over low heat until the top browns, then carefully flip onto the other side until the surface is golden, and transfer to a plate.

instructions.1: Grate the onion and rub it with salt, pepper, and mint.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs well, then mix them with the onion and the tablespoon of milk or cream.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan and pour in the egg mixture, shaking the pan to ensure the omelet sets and the surface browns.
instructions.4: Gently flip to the other side until the other surface browns, then serve on a plate.
instructions.5: You can add olives while whisking the eggs, or diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, chopped peppers, or thin fried potatoes for a lovely flavor; alternatively, you can add minced meat (osag) or luncheon meat slices—mix these ingredients thoroughly with the whisked eggs before pouring into the pan.

instructions.1: Heat the oil or ghee, then add the grated onion and sauté until it turns golden.
instructions.2: Add the finely chopped pepper and the chopped or grated tomato, and stir briefly with the onion.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs and season with salt, pepper, and spices, then add them to the mixture and stir well over medium heat until the eggs are set.
instructions.4: Serve in a dish while hot.

instructions.1: Sauté the garlic in oil or ghee until golden, then add the tomatoes.
instructions.2: Once the tomatoes are cooked, pour in the fava beans and season with salt and cumin over low heat until boiling.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs well and season with salt.
instructions.4: Prepare a Pyrex dish sized to the amount of beans and eggs, pour in the bean mixture, and pour the eggs over it.
instructions.5: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Peel the fava beans and mash them well with a fork.
instructions.2: Sauté the onion in oil or ghee until golden, then remove and let it cool slightly.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs and season with salt, pepper, and cumin, then mix in the sautéed onions.
instructions.4: Add the mashed fava beans and parsley to the egg and onion mixture and mix well.
instructions.5: Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the mixture, and fry it like an omelet, flipping to cook both sides.
instructions.6: Garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Sauté the onion in oil or ghee until golden, then add the minced garlic and coriander.
instructions.2: Add the cup of tomatoes to the onion over low heat until the tomatoes are cooked through.
instructions.3: Add the fava beans and stir for about 10 minutes, adding water if necessary.
instructions.4: Add the chopped parsley, stir with the beans, and remove from heat.
instructions.5: Add the minced meat mixture (asaag) to the beans according to taste.

sv7-5.name: green pepper, shredded cheese, and olives (for garnish)

instructions.1: Whisk the egg and season with a little salt, pepper, and mint.
instructions.2: Dip the slice of toast into the egg and let it sit for a moment to soak, then carefully flip it to the other side until the egg is fully absorbed.
instructions.3: Place butter in a small non-stick pan and heat it, then carefully place the toast in the pan over low heat.
instructions.4: After a short while, carefully flip it to the other side until both sides turn golden brown, then remove and place on a plate.
instructions.5: Garnish using small slices of green pepper with shredded Romano cheese and sliced olives; alternatively, you can spread the toast with any type of cheese and top with luncheon meat slices, green pepper slices, and olives around it.

instructions.1: Prepare a small bowl and mix the za'atar with the oil.
instructions.2: Season the toast with the za'atar mixture, then carefully coat it in flour or breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Toast on both sides in butter or oil until golden.
instructions.4: You can place another slice of toast on top, prepared in the same manner.

sv9-5.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme

instructions.1: Carefully flatten the slice of toast using a rolling pin.
instructions.2: Sauté the onion in oil, then mix it with a little of the shredded chicken seasoned with salt, pepper, spices, and thyme.
instructions.3: Stuff the toast with a small amount of this mixture.
instructions.4: Roll the toast into a finger shape, then coat it in flour, then egg, and finally breadcrumbs.
instructions.5: Place in the refrigerator until firm, then fry in hot oil.
instructions.6: Repeat this process according to the number of family members.

instructions.1: Cut the toast into circles and spread the surface with mayonnaise or a tahini sauce mixed with vinegar, water, salt, and cumin.
instructions.2: Mix the cooked peas with a small amount of the grated carrots and the cream cheese triangles.
instructions.3: Spread this mixture onto the toast that has been spread with mayonnaise or tahini.
instructions.4: Cover with another slice of toast, then dip in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing with your hand until they stick together, then fry in oil on both sides.

sv11-4.name: osag (savory minced meat; see Bab Al Lahm)

instructions.1: Sauté the minced garlic in oil with the green pepper.
instructions.2: Spread this mixture onto the toast.
instructions.3: Layer the osag on top, followed by the cheese squares and the luncheon meat slices.
instructions.4: Cover with a second slice of toast and garnish with lettuce and tomato rings.

sv12-2.name: flour
sv12-2.standardAmount: as needed for a sticky dough

instructions.1: Dissolve a little salt in the yogurt and stir well, then gradually add the flour while stirring continuously until a medium-soft dough forms.
instructions.2: Cover and leave in a warm place for more than an hour.
instructions.3: Boil just enough broth to match the amount of dough so the kishk does not become too liquid.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt and flour mixture to the broth, stirring continuously with a whisk over medium heat.
instructions.5: Let the mixture boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly until the consistency thickens.
instructions.6: Fry the onion in ghee or oil, then pour only half of it over the kishk, stir well, and remove from heat.
instructions.7: Serve in bowls and garnish with the remaining fried onions.

quick-01.title: Chicken Shawarma Sandwich with Lebanese Cream

instructions.1: Slice the raw chicken into thin, small pieces and add the minced garlic and ghee or oil; season with thyme, red pepper, and 1 tsp of curry.
instructions.2: Place in a pot over low heat until the liquid evaporates, adding a little water if necessary until cooked through.
instructions.3: Stir the cream with a wooden spoon, pour it over the chicken, and mix well; then leave over low heat for approximately 5 minutes while stirring.
instructions.4: Season with thyme, red pepper, and curry.
instructions.5: Stuff into the serving bread.

instructions.1: Sauté the sliced onion in oil, then add the sliced tomatoes and sliced peppers, and add them to the chicken breast pieces.
instructions.2: Transfer to a pot over low heat and add water until cooked through.
instructions.3: Pour the labneh over the chicken and stir over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Stuff into serving bread.

instructions.1: Mix the minced chicken with the onion, garlic, egg, salt, pepper, spices, and oil thoroughly, then let it rest in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
instructions.2: Shape the mixture into round patties.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a non-stick pan and place each patty in the pan over low heat, flipping until cooked through.
instructions.4: Prepare the buns by filling them with the chicken patties, adding ketchup, green pepper slices, and cheddar cheese.

qk4-5.name: Salt, pepper, mixed spices, thyme, and dried mint

instructions.1: Prepare the Kaiser rolls by cutting them from the top and removing the bread crumb from the center.
instructions.2: Finely chop the boiled chicken or beef (pastirma can also be used).
instructions.3: Add the shredded cheese and the egg to the meat, season with all the spices, and mix well.
instructions.4: Prepare the rolls and stuff them using a spoon through the top opening.
instructions.5: Arrange them in a greased tray and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: After removing from the oven, seal the top opening with an olive.

instructions.1: Finely chop the boiled, roasted, or grilled chicken and season it with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.2: Mix the yogurt with the vinegar, lemon juice, and finely chopped green pepper; you may also add 1 tsp of mustard, then mix thoroughly with the seasoned chicken.
instructions.3: Prepare the kaizer rolls or Baladi bread by cutting them into 4 parts, separating the top from the bottom, and lightly brushing them with butter.
instructions.4: Place 1 tbsp of the mixture onto the bread and fold it like a croissant, or stuff the mixture into the kaizer rolls.
instructions.5: Wrap the bread or rolls in foil, repeating until the mixture is finished.
instructions.6: Place them on a tray and bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Serve on plates lined with lettuce leaves.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with the cooked minced meat and stir well, then add the finely chopped green pepper, garlic, minced parsley, and mustard to the mixture.
instructions.2: Place the mixture in an ungreased tray, top with tomato slices and plenty of lemon juice, and turn on the broiler until the meat is fully absorbed.
instructions.3: Prepare the kaizer rolls to be stuffed with the mixture.

qk7-1.name: Chicken pane breaded with egg and breadcrumbs (see Bab Al Lahom recipe)

instructions.1: After frying the chicken pane, prepare the Kaiser rolls and spread them with mayonnaise.
instructions.2: Place the chicken pane inside the rolls, then top with ketchup, lettuce leaves, a slice of luncheon meat, green pepper rings, and finally the cheese slices.

quick-08.title: Tuna Sandwich with Mayonnaise or Tahini

instructions.1: Drain the tuna from the oil, then mix it with the mayonnaise (or the tahini mixed with water, vinegar, and lemon juice).
instructions.2: Add the finely chopped pickles, minced garlic, finely chopped green onion, and small tomato pieces, then mix well.
instructions.3: Place the filling inside the kaiser rolls and top with bell pepper rings.

db96-7.name: Milk or yogurt
db96-7.standardAmount: 1 cup or 1 large cup of yogurt

instructions.1: Beat the butter or ghee thoroughly until it turns pale, then gradually add the sugar while continuing to whisk.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one by one, beating well after each addition, then add the vanilla and lemon zest.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it gradually, alternating with the milk or yogurt, until the mixture is combined.
instructions.4: Grease a baking pan with ghee and dust it with flour, then pour in the batter and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.5: You can color a portion of the batter with cocoa to create a marbled cake.

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs, then gradually add the sugar, followed by a gradual addition of the oil.
instructions.3: Gradually pour in the flour mixture, sprinkle with cinnamon, and finally add the carrots, mixing well by hand.
instructions.4: Grease the baking pan, pour in the mixture, spread it evenly, and shake the pan before placing it in the oven.
instructions.5: Once removed from the oven, do not cover the pan until it has cooled completely.

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour.
instructions.2: Cream the sugar and butter together with a whisk, then add the semolina and coconut, mixing well.
instructions.3: Whisk the egg whites with the vanilla and fold them into the previous mixture.
instructions.4: Add the flour to the dough and knead well until homogeneous.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into eye shapes and arrange them on a lightly greased baking tray.
instructions.6: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.
instructions.7: Drizzle with cold simple syrup and arrange on a serving plate.

vl40-5.name: minced meat filling (see Bab Al Louhoum)

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes, peel them, and mash them thoroughly.
instructions.2: Prepare a pan, melt the ghee or butter in it, then add the mashed potatoes.
instructions.3: Remove from heat and let it cool, then season with salt, pepper, and shredded cheese.
instructions.4: Place a little oil in a small dish to lightly grease your hands so the potato dough does not stick.
instructions.5: Shape into small balls and make a well in the center to fill with the minced meat.
instructions.6: Dip the balls in the egg, then the breadcrumbs, and fry in generous oil.

bk10-6.name: minced meat mixture (optional, see Bab al-Lahm)

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast in warm water with a little sugar, cover, and let it rise.
instructions.2: Add the oil to the flour, then knead with water until a cohesive dough of the desired consistency forms; add the yeast and knead well.
instructions.3: Roll out the dough with a rolling pin on a floured surface, then cut into appropriate pieces using a round or square cutter.
instructions.4: Fill each piece with the spinach mixture, adding the minced meat to the filling if available, then fold the piece carefully.
instructions.5: Grease a baking tray with oil, arrange the pies in the tray, brush the tops with oil, and bake in a medium-heat oven until the tops are golden brown.

veg-42.title: Batates Bel Dam'a (Potatoes in Tomato Sauce)

vl43-2.name: dam'a (soft tomato sauce, see next recipe)

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into cubes, fry them in oil, and set aside on paper towels.
instructions.2: Prepare about one cup of the dam'a; do not use too much as the potatoes will not need a long time to cook through.
instructions.3: Add the fried potatoes to the dam'a and cover the pot over medium heat until the potatoes are cooked.

des-72.title: Malban (Turkish Delight) Filling
des-72.servings: enough for one batch of Kahk dough

instructions.1: Cut the malban into small pieces and mix with the walnuts.

veg-35.title: Potato Tray in the Oven (Siniyet Batates)

instructions.1: Slice the potatoes into somewhat thick rounds and leave them soaking in water with salt and vinegar.
instructions.2: Slice the onions into thin rings and rub them well with salt and pepper; slice the green pepper into rings and mince the garlic.
instructions.3: Cut the meat or chicken into pieces and season with salt and pepper (this step is optional).
instructions.4: Heat oil in a pot, add the onion rings and minced garlic, and sauté until the moisture has evaporated.
instructions.5: Add the meat cubes or chicken pieces and sauté them with the onion and garlic until fully browned.
instructions.6: Add the pepper rings and stir once, then pour in the tomato juice or the tomato paste diluted with water, and bring to a boil.
instructions.7: Prepare a greased baking tray and layer the potatoes alternately with the meat or chicken mixture of onion, garlic, pepper, and tomato.
instructions.8: Pour water over the vegetables according to the amount of potatoes and season with salt and pepper; top with small tomato slices and 1 tablespoon of oil.
instructions.9: Cover the tray and place it in a medium-heat oven; before it is fully cooked, remove the cover so the potatoes can absorb the remaining liquid.

instructions.1: Caramelize 4 tablespoons of sugar in a pot over the heat without water, shaking the pot constantly until the sugar turns golden, being careful not to burn it.
instructions.2: Add the remaining sugar and then add the water; cover the pot and leave it over low heat until it boils and the sugar is completely dissolved, then add the vanilla.
instructions.3: Arrange the toast in a Pyrex dish or serving tray, placing two layers of toast on top of each other until the quantity is finished.
instructions.4: Pour the hot syrup over the toast, pressing down with a spoon until it is completely absorbed, then leave it to cool.
instructions.5: Garnish with either cream or whipped Chantilly cream, spreading it over the top until the toast is completely covered.
instructions.6: Sprinkle with crushed pistachios or nuts.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee in a pan over low heat, then add the flour and stir until it turns golden.
instructions.2: Dissolve the sugar in the water by either blending them in a mixer or boiling them on the stove beforehand with the vanilla, then let the mixture cool.
instructions.3: Pour the sugar solution over the flour mixture and stir until the liquid is fully absorbed.
instructions.4: Prepare a flat dish, spread the dough evenly, and cover with nuts and coconut.

vl36-1.name: Assorted vegetables (eggplant, green beans, potatoes, peas)

instructions.1: Prepare the vegetables after washing them, then slice the onions, tomatoes, green pepper, and carrots into rings and mince the garlic; season them with salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon of vinegar, then mix well.
instructions.2: Prepare a greased baking tray and layer the vegetables and the cut meat alternately.
instructions.3: Add 2 cups of boiling water mixed with 2 tablespoons of oil and salt.
instructions.4: Cover the tray and place it in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.

des-73.title: Ajamia Filling
des-73.servings: enough for one batch of Kahk dough

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and add the flour and kahk flavoring (or vanilla); stir over low heat until the flour turns golden, then add the sesame seeds until golden, then remove the pan from the heat.
instructions.2: Gradually add the honey while stirring well, then return the pan to the stove, stirring continuously until the mixture thickens.
instructions.3: Remove from the heat and sprinkle with vanilla if using, then set aside to cool.

instructions.1: Finely chop the spinach, wash it thoroughly, and squeeze out all excess water; then add salt, pepper, and lemon juice, and massage the mixture well.
instructions.2: Boiled vegetables such as peas, carrots, and green peppers can be used with sautéed onions and spices, then mixed with a spoonful of mustard and mashed cheese, or boiled shredded chicken can be used with sautéed onions and spices.

instructions.1: Lightly sauté the garlic in ghee or oil, then add the tomato puree and cook until thickened.
instructions.2: Add the tablespoon of vinegar and stir well, then add the water and season with salt and pepper, leaving it to simmer until boiling.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in their skins; once cooked, peel them and mash them while they are still very hot.
instructions.2: In a saucepan, combine the milk, butter or ghee, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil, then remove from heat.
instructions.3: Add the mashed potatoes to the liquid and mix thoroughly until completely combined, then serve hot.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the sugar using an electric mixer, then add the oil, melted chocolate, and vanilla.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the baking powder, add it to the mixture, and stir well with a spoon until the batter becomes elastic.
instructions.3: Line a tray with foil, pour the mixture into it, sprinkle nuts and coconut on top, and spread the batter with a spoon to fill the entire tray.
instructions.4: Place in a high-temperature oven.
instructions.5: Once baked, the cake will be easy to lift out using the foil, then slice it.
instructions.6: Garnish with grated chocolate if desired.

db74-5.name: powdered sugar and coconut for serving

instructions.1: Prepare a wide, high-sided pot and fill it halfway with water; place a steamer sieve over it, sealing the edges with a dough made from flour and water, then place over medium heat until boiling.
instructions.2: Place the couscous in a cheesecloth of appropriate size and fold the edges into the sieve to cover it, then cover with the pot lid and leave over low heat for 20 to 30 minutes.
instructions.3: Carefully remove the cheesecloth from the sieve and spread the couscous in a bowl, using a fork to fluff and separate the grains, then let it rest; sprinkle with 1 cup of cold water or broth and gently loosen the grains by hand.
instructions.4: Return the couscous to the cheesecloth, place it back in the sieve, cover, and cook for a second time for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove from the cheesecloth and place in a bowl over low heat, add the ghee to taste, and stir with a fork while hot.
instructions.6: Serve in a dish and sprinkle with powdered sugar and coconut.

instructions.1: Combine all ingredients over low heat until the mixture becomes liquid.

vl27-4.name: salt, pepper, crushed cardamom, and bay leaves

instructions.1: Peel the eggplant, cut it into slices, sprinkle with salt, and place in a colander over a bowl to drain the excess water.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pot and add the small beef cubes; sauté them with the minced onion until golden, then season with salt, pepper, crushed cardamom, and bay leaves.
instructions.3: Add water and vinegar to the pot, cover, and simmer over low heat until the meat is cooked, then remove the meat from the broth.
instructions.4: Wash 2 cups of rice and soak in warm water.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan to fry the eggplant, then drain on paper towels.
instructions.6: Prepare a cooking pot and layer slices of pepper and tomato at the bottom to prevent the rice from sticking.
instructions.7: Begin layering the pot by placing a layer of rice, followed by a layer of meat, then a layer of fried eggplant; repeat this order, then cook over low heat until the rice is tender.
instructions.8: Carefully flip the pot onto a serving dish to invert the eggplant, meat, and rice.
instructions.9: Garnish with parsley and toasted pine nuts, and serve with yogurt salad.

instructions.1: Add the salt, fennel, and anise to the flour.
instructions.2: Make a well in the center of the flour and place the sesame seeds inside.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee and pour it into the well, then stir well with a wooden spoon until the temperature cools, rub well by hand, then add the sugar and rub together.
instructions.4: Rub the yeast with a little sugar until it dissolves, then add a little warm water, then add it to the flour and knead well while gradually adding warm water until the dough becomes somewhat firm.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and leave it to ferment.
instructions.6: Cut the dough and shape into equal-sized rounds.
instructions.7: Prepare a baking sheet lightly dusted with flour, place the dough on it, brush the tops with melted ghee, and leave to ferment again.
instructions.8: Bake in a medium-heat oven until done.

instructions.1: Prepare a cooking pot and add the grated onion (rubbed with salt and pepper), the minced garlic, and the rice or soaked chickpeas along with the chopped spinach; cook over low heat with the pot covered until the spinach absorbs all the liquid.
instructions.2: Mix this mixture with the minced meat (2-3 tbsp of osag), then transfer it to a Pyrex dish.
instructions.3: Whisk 4 eggs with salt and pepper, pour them over the spinach, and drizzle 2 tablespoons of oil or ghee on top.
instructions.4: Place in a medium-heat oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Mix the ghee with the flour thoroughly, then whisk the eggs and knead them into the flour, adding a little water until a soft dough forms.
instructions.2: Roll out the dough on a floured surface using a rolling pin and cut it into strips approximately 2 cm wide.
instructions.3: Roll each strip into a circle and deep-fry in hot oil.
instructions.4: Place in cold simple syrup, drain, and sprinkle with coconut.

vl49-3.name: salt, pepper, cumin, mixed spices, and thyme

instructions.1: Slice the potatoes into medium-thick rings and parboil them.
instructions.2: Prepare the mixture by combining the spices, minced garlic, and milk, stirring well.
instructions.3: Coat the potatoes in this mixture, then dredge them in salted flour.
instructions.4: Fry in oil until golden.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, and baking powder together.
instructions.2: Place the water in a pot with the ghee or butter and bring to a boil, then add the flour one cup at a time.
instructions.3: Continue stirring over medium heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Remove from heat and let it cool.
instructions.5: Add the eggs one by one, kneading by hand until the dough comes together smoothly.
instructions.6: Cut into appropriate sizes, deep-fry in hot oil until golden, then remove and soak in cold simple syrup.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with a mixer for 5 minutes on high speed.
instructions.2: Add the sugar to the eggs, then add the yogurt and beat on low speed.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the baking powder and gradually pour it into the mixture while beating on low speed.
instructions.4: After the flour is well incorporated into the batter, beat on high speed for one minute.
instructions.5: Grease the baking pan thoroughly with ghee and flour.
instructions.6: Place in the oven at medium temperature until cooked through and the top is golden brown.
instructions.7: Immediately after removing from the oven, prick the entire cake with a fork, especially the center.
instructions.8: Pour half of the syrup using a ladle so it does not leak to the sides; after 5 minutes, pour the second half of the syrup.
instructions.9: Leave to cool without a cover, then flip onto a serving plate.
instructions.10: Garnish by brushing the surface with jam then topping with whipped cream and strawberries, or sprinkle with coconut, or top with sliced fruit without whipped cream.

instructions.1: Separate the egg yolks from the whites, then beat the yolks with the sugar until the mixture thickens, adding the vanilla.
instructions.2: Whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
instructions.3: Mix the flour and cornstarch together, then gradually add them to the egg whites.
instructions.4: Add the mixture to the egg yolk and sugar mixture all at once, folding gently.
instructions.5: Grease rectangular molds thoroughly with melted ghee and dust them with flour.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the molds and shape into finger-like strips.
instructions.7: Bake in a medium-heat oven.

vl31-2.name: osag (minced meat mixture; see Bab Al-Lahm)

instructions.1: Remove the outer green leaves, then trim the sides and bottom; cut off the top and divide each artichoke into halves or quarters.
instructions.2: Immediately place them in water with added lemon juice or vinegar to prevent browning.
instructions.3: Parboil the artichokes, or you may skip boiling them entirely.
instructions.4: Lightly fry them in oil and set aside on paper towels.
instructions.5: Cook the osag using the standard method, adding ½ cup of tomatoes and 1 tbsp of vinegar until cooked through.
instructions.6: Arrange the artichokes neatly in a Pyrex dish or baking tray, layering the osag between them.
instructions.7: Pour 1 cup of boiling broth or water over the dish and place in the oven.
instructions.8: Optional: Pour the bechamel sauce (1 cup) over the artichokes.

db86-7.name: jam, melted chocolate, and nuts for decoration

instructions.1: Cream the ghee and sugar together thoroughly until the mixture reaches a creamy consistency.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the vanilla, then add them to the sugar and ghee mixture and whisk well.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the baking powder, then add it to the mixture until a suitable dough forms.
instructions.4: Pipe the dough onto an ungreased baking sheet using a petit four machine or a piping bag to create fingers or rose shapes.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderately low oven, then let them cool completely after removal.
instructions.6: Sandwich pairs together with jam and decorate the tops with melted chocolate and nuts.
instructions.7: Cocoa powder or melted chocolate can be added to the dough to make chocolate petit fours.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into slices or cubes.
instructions.2: Fry them in oil and set aside on paper towels.
instructions.3: Sauté the onion in oil in another pot over low heat, then add the minced garlic and the broth seasoned with salt and cumin.
instructions.4: Add the fried potatoes to the broth, cover, and leave over low heat until the potatoes are cooked and the broth has mostly absorbed.

veg-52.title: Tips for Preserving and Freezing Vegetables

vl52-2.name: Boiling salted water with added bicarbonate (baking soda)

vl52-5.name: Hot broth or soup (for freezing molokhia)
vl52-5.standardAmount: 1 ladle per amount of minced molokhia

vl52-6.name: Olive oil and plenty of lemon juice (for preserving artichokes)

vl52-7.name: White vinegar (for cooling potato slices)
vl52-7.standardAmount: a little, added to the cooling water

instructions.1: Preserving the green color: Boil water with salt and bicarbonate, then place the vegetables in it for only one minute. Remove them immediately and place them in ice water to stop the cooking process and maintain their bright green color.
instructions.2: Freezing vegetables: After cleaning and washing the vegetables, place them in the boiling salted water with bicarbonate as described above. Drain them immediately in a colander and pour ice water directly over them. Place them in a bag, press firmly by hand to remove the air, then seal, label with the date, and store in the freezer for up to 3 months. When using, pour them directly from the freezer into hot soup.
instructions.3: Freezing molokhia: After washing, cutting, and mincing the molokhia, pour exactly one ladle of broth or soup over it, then store it in an airtight bag in the freezer until use.
instructions.4: Preserving artichokes in the refrigerator: Place the artichokes in boiling water with added olive oil and plenty of lemon juice, then remove them and place them in an airtight glass container and store in the refrigerator.
instructions.5: Freezing potatoes: Cut the potatoes into medium-thick slices and place them in boiling water on the stove for 3-4 minutes. Drain and place them in cold water with added vinegar. Once cooled, place them in a colander to dry completely, then wrap them in bags and store in the freezer. When frying, remove them from the freezer and fry them directly while frozen.

instructions.1: Slice the potatoes into thin rounds, grease a Pyrex dish with oil, and place half of the potatoes in it.
instructions.2: Heat the milk to the same volume as the potatoes and season it with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Pour some of the hot milk over the potatoes, then add the shredded cheese.
instructions.4: Layer the remaining potatoes, pour the rest of the milk over them, and top with more shredded cheese.
instructions.5: Place in a medium-heat oven with 1 tablespoon of oil or ghee, and cover until cooked through.

instructions.1: Cream the ghee or butter with the sugar until the mixture becomes fluffy.
instructions.2: Add the whisked eggs with vanilla and the dates to the sugar mixture and mix well.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it to the mixture until a somewhat firm dough forms.
instructions.4: Roll out the dough on a tray to a thickness of 0.5 cm and cut into circles.
instructions.5: Brush the surface of the biscuits with a little egg wash and sprinkle with the minced peanuts mixed with a little sugar.
instructions.6: Place in a hot oven for 10 minutes, then leave to cool once cooked.

veg-28.title: Boiled Artichokes with Oil and Lemon

instructions.1: Remove the outer green leaves, then trim the sides and the bottom; cut off the top and divide the artichoke into halves or quarters.
instructions.2: Immediately place them in water with added lemon juice or vinegar to prevent them from turning brown.
instructions.3: Boil the artichokes in boiling water with added salt and lemon juice.
instructions.4: Once cooked, prepare a bowl and combine the oil, juice of one lemon, salt, pepper, and minced garlic, stirring the mixture well to thicken it.
instructions.5: Season the boiled artichokes with this mixture and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Cream the sugar with the butter until the mixture turns pale, then add the eggs and whisk well, followed by the milk and vanilla, and finally fold in the flour mixed with baking powder gradually until a soft batter forms.
instructions.2: Pour the batter into small molds and bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.
instructions.3: Garnish with cream and top with cherries or any preferred fruit.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the baking powder, add the butter, and rub with your fingertips until the butter is completely incorporated into the flour.
instructions.2: Add the cinnamon and sugar and mix well with the beaten eggs, then combine all ingredients until a medium-soft dough forms, adding a little milk if needed to reach the desired consistency.
instructions.3: Roll out the dough with a rolling pin and cut into round circles: one solid piece and another with a small hole in the middle, until the dough is used up.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium-heat oven, then leave to cool once removed.
instructions.5: Sandwich the solid biscuit with the one containing the hole using jam as glue.
instructions.6: Dust the surface with powdered sugar and garnish the center with crushed nuts.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee over heat, then add the milk and sugar.
instructions.2: Return to heat and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved, then set aside to cool.
instructions.3: Add the shredded coconut, followed by the flour mixed with baking powder, and stir well until the mixture thickens.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a well-greased tray and cut into diamond shapes.
instructions.5: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Slice the potatoes into very thin slices or rings and soak them in water with salt and vinegar for a while to remove the starch.
instructions.2: Drain them thoroughly, then fry in a pan with medium-heat oil for only 3 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the potatoes from the oil, place them on paper towels, and then put them in a freezer bag inside the freezer to freeze.
instructions.4: When ready to use, fry them in hot oil while still frozen.

instructions.1: Mix all the ingredients together thoroughly.
instructions.2: Grease a tray with ghee and shape the mixture into small balls using a spoon or by hand.
instructions.3: Bake in the oven for half an hour at medium temperature until golden brown.

vl34-6.name: garlic, minced and soaked in olive oil for 24 hours

instructions.1: Wash and chop the spinach. In a pot, sauté the minced onion, then add the soaked garlic, anise, cumin, and ground pepper, and sauté well.
instructions.2: Add the tomato paste diluted with water and salt, then add the boiled chickpeas, and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Once boiling, add the spinach over very high heat to preserve its nutritional value.
instructions.4: Add the dill, lemon juice, and water if needed; cover the pot and leave over medium heat until cooked through.

des-75.title: Fiteer bel Ajwa (Flaky Pastry with Date Paste)

instructions.1: Peel the dates, remove pits, and process them in a food processor.
instructions.2: Mix the date paste with about 2 tablespoons of the reserved ghee until smooth.
instructions.3: Add the salt, fennel, and anise to the flour.
instructions.4: Make a well in the center of the flour and add the sesame seeds into it.
instructions.5: Heat the ghee and pour it into the well, then stir well with a wooden spoon until the temperature cools, rub the mixture well by hand, then add the sugar and rub together.
instructions.6: Dissolve the yeast in a little sugar until liquid, then add a little warm water, then add it to the flour and knead well, gradually adding warm water until the dough becomes somewhat firm.
instructions.7: Cover the dough and leave it to rise.
instructions.8: Take pieces of dough one by one, roll them into balls, and make a well in the center to place a piece of date paste inside, then seal the dough and flatten it; repeat until all ingredients are used.
instructions.9: Arrange the pastries on a baking sheet and leave for a short time to rise, then bake in a medium-heat oven.

veg-24.title: Fried Eggplant with Vinegar and Garlic

instructions.1: Peel the eggplant, cut into medium rounds, and place in a colander over a bowl; sprinkle with salt to draw out the moisture, then pat dry.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a frying pan, fry the eggplant on both sides until golden, and drain on paper towels.
instructions.3: Prepare the sauce by combining garlic, vinegar, salt, pepper, oil, and water: heat the oil and sauté the garlic until golden, then add the vinegar while stirring, followed by the water; season with salt and pepper, stir well, and remove from heat.
instructions.4: Place the eggplant in the sauce and cover until it is fully absorbed, then transfer to a serving dish.

instructions.1: Combine the sugar and water in a pot and heat over medium heat for two minutes until boiling and the syrup thickens slightly.
instructions.2: Place the coconut in another bowl, then add the sugar syrup once it has cooled slightly and mix well.
instructions.3: Spread the coconut mixture into a medium tray and press it down firmly by hand.
instructions.4: Top with raisins, chopped nuts, and pistachios, pressing them firmly into the coconut mixture.
instructions.5: Place in the refrigerator until cold and firm, then cut into squares.
instructions.6: Alternatively, toast the coconut in a non-stick pan without butter until golden, then prepare as described in the previous steps.

instructions.1: Wash the spinach and the bunch of dill, then chop them coarsely.
instructions.2: Blend the tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, and vinegar in a blender.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a pot, add the blended mixture, and let it come to a boil; then add the spinach and dill, stirring occasionally over low heat.
instructions.4: Add small amounts of broth as needed until it reaches a near-cooked consistency.
instructions.5: Soak 1 tablespoon of rice for a while, drain it, and add it to the spinach to cook along with it; alternatively, you can use soaked dried chickpeas.
instructions.6: Once the spinach is fully cooked, remove from heat and stir in the garlic tadka.

instructions.1: Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, then whisk in the eggs and vanilla, followed by the grated carrots, mixing well.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the baking powder, add it to the mixture, and stir well until combined.
instructions.3: Shape the biscuits using a biscuit maker, arrange them on a baking sheet, and bake in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.4: Immediately after baking, carefully remove the biscuits from the trays and let them cool.

instructions.1: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the cornstarch, and whisk well.
instructions.2: Boil the milk sweetened with sugar, then remove from heat and add the egg mixture, whisking well to combine; return to low heat while whisking constantly until thickened, then sprinkle with vanilla.

instructions.1: Cut the cauliflower and remove the thick stems.
instructions.2: Place it in boiling water seasoned with salt and cumin, ensuring the florets are facing down and the stems are facing up, until partially cooked.
instructions.3: Remove using a strainer to drain, then fry in oil until golden and set aside on paper towels.
instructions.4: Blend the onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and garlic with salt and pepper in a blender, then sauté this mixture in a pan with oil until it boils.
instructions.5: Prepare a Pyrex dish or baking tray and add the fried cauliflower and the minced meat mixture (optional), then mix well with the vegetable sauce.
instructions.6: Cover with béchamel sauce, top with a knob of butter and a sprinkle of cheese, and bake in a medium oven until cooked through.

vl51-4.name: salt, pepper, spice mix, thyme, curry, and ginger

instructions.1: Slice the onions into thin rings and season them thoroughly with all the spices.
instructions.2: Coat the onions in flour, then cornstarch, then dip them in the egg.
instructions.3: Coat them again in flour, then cornstarch, and dip them in the egg once more.
instructions.4: Let them rest in the refrigerator for a short while.
instructions.5: Fry in oil until golden and drain on paper towels.

instructions.1: Break up the kunafa pastry into fine strands using your fingers.
instructions.2: Sauté the kunafa in the melted ghee until it turns golden brown.
instructions.3: Drizzle with cold simple syrup.
instructions.4: Spread half of the kunafa in a round dish, then layer the cream or clotted cream on top.
instructions.5: Add the remaining kunafa and press down firmly with your hands.
instructions.6: Garnish with either pistachios or hazelnuts.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-length slices.
instructions.2: Grease a baking tray with ghee or oil and arrange the slices side by side.
instructions.3: Pour the hot sauce over the potatoes, add the milk or water, cover the tray, and place in a medium oven until cooked through.

instructions.1: Melt the butter, ghee, or oil in a pan, then add the tomato paste along with ½ tsp sugar, salt, pepper, and a little water.
instructions.2: Finely dice the tomato and garlic, add them to the sauce, and stir until cooked through.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs well with the sugar, then add the ghee and mix thoroughly; then combine the flour with the baking powder and mix it with the egg mixture, yogurt, vanilla, and lemon zest.
instructions.2: Take a portion of the batter and mix it with the cocoa powder and milk, whisking until the consistency is thinner than the rest of the batter.
instructions.3: Grease the baking pan well with ghee and dust it with flour; pour half of the cake batter into the pan, then pour the cocoa-milk mixture over it, and finally top with the remaining cake batter.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through and the color turns slightly golden brown.

instructions.1: After sorting and washing the split fava beans, place them in a pot with enough water to cover them; bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then drain the water.
instructions.2: In a pot, add more water along with the thinly sliced onions, celery, mint, and the soaked fava beans.
instructions.3: Cook over low heat without stirring, adding water whenever necessary, until the beans are completely soft and broken down.
instructions.4: Once cooled, blend the mixture in a blender and pass it through a fine-mesh strainer.
instructions.5: Return the pot to the heat, add salt and mint, and let it simmer while stirring continuously over low heat, adding a little water if needed until the consistency is right and not too thin.
instructions.6: Pour the fried onion garnish (ta'leya) over the bissara and stir, then serve in bowls garnished with the remaining fried onions.

instructions.1: Combine the sugar, water, and lemon juice over low heat; once the sugar has dissolved and the mixture thickens slightly, add the butter while the color is still pale.
instructions.2: Stir continuously until the mixture turns yellow or slightly darker.
instructions.3: Remove the pan from the heat and arrange the pieces of cooked pineapple or peaches (khoshaf) inside according to your preference.
instructions.4: Leave the pan until it cools and the caramel sets.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with an electric mixer, then add the sugar, followed by the oil or melted ghee, the juice, lemon or orange zest, and vanilla.
instructions.2: Once the sugar has dissolved, gradually add the flour until fully combined.
instructions.3: Carefully pour the cake batter over the cold caramel in the pan.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.
instructions.5: As soon as the pan is removed from the oven, lightly prick holes in the cake with a fork.
instructions.6: Prepare a serving plate the same size as the pan, place the plate over the cake, and carefully flip them; leave the pan on top as a cover so the cake absorbs all the caramel.
instructions.7: Once cooled, you can garnish with nuts and coconut.

instructions.1: Cream the butter, sugar, egg, coconut, and vanilla in a mixer, then add the flour mixed with the baking powder.
instructions.2: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Shape the dough into small spheres, roughly the size of a large lemon.
instructions.4: Grease a baking tray with oil and place the spheres on it, leaving plenty of space between them.
instructions.5: Bake in a medium-heat oven until golden and cooked through.
instructions.6: Immediately after removing from the oven, drizzle each piece with simple syrup using a spoon.
instructions.7: You can also drizzle each piece with melted chocolate and top with crushed hazelnuts.

vl48-4.name: salt, pepper, cumin, dried mint, thyme, and baharat spice

instructions.1: Prepare a saucepan, add all the sauce ingredients, and place over low heat just to warm through.

bk15-6.name: baking powder or yeast
bk15-6.standardAmount: 1 tsp baking powder or 2 tsp yeast

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast in a little warm water and a little sugar, and let it sit to proof for 15 minutes.
instructions.2: Rub the flour with the oil, then add the yogurt and mix well; add the yeast and knead thoroughly until soft, adding water as needed.
instructions.3: Leave the dough to rise in a warm place for about one hour.
instructions.4: Grease a tray with oil and lightly dust it with flour to prevent sticking, then place the dough in the tray and spread it out.
instructions.5: Sauté one finely minced small onion in ghee or oil, then add 2 minced garlic cloves.
instructions.6: Cut the boiled chicken into small pieces and mix with the onion, then add the tomato sauce and stir well.
instructions.7: Pour the mixture over the pizza and garnish with pieces of sausage, olives, and onion slices.

instructions.1: Mix the nuts with the coconut, raisins, and sugar.
instructions.2: Place a portion of the filling into the Qatayef shells, then fold them in half, pressing the edges to seal them.
instructions.3: Fry in hot ghee or oil until golden, then remove from heat.
instructions.4: Dip into cold simple syrup, remove quickly, and place on a serving plate.
instructions.5: Garnish with a sprinkle of crushed pistachios or hazelnuts.

instructions.1: Dice the potatoes and fry them in oil until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
instructions.2: Sauté the chopped onions in the same oil until they turn golden.
instructions.3: Pour the fried potatoes over the sautéed onions, then mix in the chopped green pepper, shredded carrots, chopped parsley, chopped coriander, chopped dill, and curry powder; season the mixture with salt, pepper, and cinnamon.
instructions.4: After mixing well, shape the mixture into round patties.
instructions.5: Fry the patties in oil and drain on paper towels.

instructions.1: Cut the cauliflower and remove the thick stems.
instructions.2: Place it in boiling water seasoned with salt and cumin, ensuring the florets are facing down and the stems are facing up, until partially cooked.
instructions.3: Remove using a strainer to drain, then fry in oil until golden and place on paper towels to drain.
instructions.4: Blend the onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and garlic with salt and pepper in a blender.
instructions.5: Sauté this mixture in a pot with oil until it boils, then add the broth.
instructions.6: Once boiling, prepare a Pyrex dish, mix the cauliflower with the minced meat, pour the sauce-mixed broth over it, and bake in a medium oven until cooked through.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs with only three-quarters of the sugar until the mixture thickens, then add the vanilla.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the baking powder, then alternately add the milk and the whisked egg mixture, mixing well.
instructions.3: Add the coconut and mix thoroughly with the remaining ingredients until the dough becomes firm.
instructions.4: Prepare a baking sheet by lightly coating it with sugar and a little coconut, then brush the top of the biscuits with the remaining milk, cut into shapes, and bake in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.5: Remove from the oven and leave to cool.

instructions.1: Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
instructions.2: Beat the egg whites thoroughly after adding 3 teaspoons of water.
instructions.3: Whisk the yolks well in a bowl, then add them to the beaten whites in a mixer along with the sugar, beating the mixture well until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it gradually to the mixture, alternating with the milk until all ingredients are incorporated.
instructions.5: Grease the pan with ghee and lightly dust with flour, then pour the cake batter into it and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.6: Once removed from the oven, let it cool, then cut it in half using a long knife.
instructions.7: Moisten the first half with a little sugar-sweetened milk, fruit syrup, or lemon-lime soda, making small holes with a fork so the liquid penetrates without collapsing the cake.
instructions.8: Pour the cream over the first half of the cake, let it cool, then arrange the chopped fruit on top.
instructions.9: Place the second half of the cake on top and lightly pierce the surface to soak it with any type of liquid.
instructions.10: Prepare white whipped cream or add cocoa to make it chocolate-colored, then spread it evenly over the surface of the cake.
instructions.11: Garnish to taste with either finely chopped chocolate, nuts, or more fruit.

veg-30.title: Boiled Spinach with Oil and Lemon

instructions.1: After washing thoroughly and picking the leaves, boil in a little boiling water with salt until tender.
instructions.2: After boiling, chop the spinach coarsely.
instructions.3: In a bowl, combine the oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and minced garlic; stir the mixture well to thicken it, then toss the spinach thoroughly in the dressing.

instructions.1: Mix the flours (corn + wheat) with the baking powder thoroughly.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs with a whisk, then add the sugar and whisk well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix well, then add the yogurt, then the tangerine zest, and finally add the flour gradually.
instructions.4: To adjust the consistency, add more flour if the batter is too thin, or a little milk if it is too thick.
instructions.5: Grease a baking tray with ghee and dust it with flour, then pour the batter into it and shake the tray to level it.
instructions.6: Bake in the oven at a low temperature until the top turns golden brown.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into small slices, then boil and mash them.
instructions.2: Prepare a pan with a little oil until hot, then add the minced garlic along with the cumin and coriander.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes in a serving dish, pour the seasoning over them with the salt and a little milk, and mix well.

bk12-6.name: Shakshuka filling or minced meat sauce (see Bab Al-Lahoum)

instructions.1: Gradually stir the flour into the milk, then beat the eggs and mix them all together well.
instructions.2: Prepare a small non-stick pan; place a little oil in a small bowl with a cotton ball to lightly grease the pan once it heats up.
instructions.3: Pour one tablespoon of the batter carefully into the pan over low heat, then flip to the other side until golden brown, and place in a large dish.
instructions.4: Repeat the process one by one until the entire mixture is used.
instructions.5: Fill each crepe with either the Shakshuka filling or the minced meat sauce, leaving the edges unfilled.
instructions.6: Roll each crepe tightly like a pencil and arrange them in a baking dish that has been very lightly greased with oil or ghee.
instructions.7: Spread tomato sauce over the top of each crepe and sprinkle with the grated cheese.
instructions.8: Bake in a medium-heat oven for about 15 minutes so the crepes do not dry out.

instructions.1: Beat the ghee well, then add the sugar and whisk until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one by one, beating well until the mixture is homogeneous, then add the vanilla.
instructions.3: Add the coconut and stir into the mixture, then add the flour and baking powder and mix well.
instructions.4: Lightly grease a baking pan with ghee, pour in the batter, and place in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.5: Immediately after removing the cake from the oven, soak it with the cold syrup, then slice.

db98-8.name: crème caramel (refer to crème caramel recipe)

instructions.1: Pour the hot caramel into the baking pan and let it cool until it sets.
instructions.2: Gradually pour the crème caramel mixture over the hardened caramel.
instructions.3: Carefully pour the cake batter over the crème caramel and prepare a water bath.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through, then let cool before flipping onto a serving plate.
instructions.5: Garnish with whipped cream around the edges, fresh fruit in the center, and jam over the whipped cream.

vl55-4.name: salt, pepper, cumin, and crushed cardamom

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans in cold water, changing the water twice daily for one week.
instructions.2: Once sprouted, boil the beans in boiling water with sliced onions seasoned with salt, pepper, cumin, and crushed cardamom; cover and leave to simmer over low heat.
instructions.3: Once cooked, squeeze lemon juice over them to taste.
instructions.4: Serving suggestion: The beans can be eaten with their skins in their cooking broth topped with cumin, oil, and lemon, or the skins can be peeled and the beans boiled in the broth with added oil, cumin, and lemon.

instructions.1: Dissolve the sugar in the water by blending in a mixer.
instructions.2: Melt the ghee in a pot, add the flour, and stir until it turns a deep golden color.
instructions.3: Remove from heat and pour in the cold sugar solution, stirring well.
instructions.4: Return to the stove and stir gently over low heat until the mixture pulls away from the sides of the pot.
instructions.5: Spread into a tray, sprinkle with coconut and nuts, and cut into squares.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs and vanilla well, then add the ghee, sugar, milk, and lemon zest.
instructions.2: Add 3 tablespoons of cocoa powder and mix well.
instructions.3: Optional: add 2 tablespoons of raisins, apricot jam, bitter orange jam, fruit compote, or chopped ripe fruit such as apples.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour mixed with the baking powder until the quantity is finished.
instructions.5: Grease the pan with ghee and lightly dust with flour over the ghee, then pour in the cake batter and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.6: Once cooled, flip the cake onto a plate and garnish by pouring hot melted chocolate over the cake.
instructions.7: After cooling, you can garnish the top with peeled hazelnuts or walnuts.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in their skins in boiling water with salt and vinegar.
instructions.2: Once cooked, peel them and mash thoroughly with a fork while still hot.
instructions.3: Prepare a pan with a little butter and heat it slightly, then add the potatoes and toss briefly until they are well combined with the butter, then remove from heat.
instructions.4: Season with salt, pepper, and chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Cream the ghee and sugar together thoroughly until the mixture reaches a creamy consistency, then add the flour until a suitable dough forms.
instructions.2: Shape into small rounds and press a blanched almond into the center of each.
instructions.3: Arrange on an ungreased baking sheet.
instructions.4: Bake in a low-temperature oven so the color does not change.
instructions.5: Once done, leave to cool completely.

instructions.1: Mix a small portion of the flour with the baking powder and set aside.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until smoking, pour it over the remaining flour, then add the flour mixed with baking powder.
instructions.3: Add the kahk flavoring and the sesame seeds.
instructions.4: Dissolve the salt in warm water, then use it to knead the dough.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small rounds and add the filling.
instructions.6: Pattern the cookies and bake them on a tray in a medium-heat oven.
instructions.7: Let them cool, then dust with powdered sugar.

db72-8.name: sugar
db72-8.standardAmount: to taste (3 tsp per cup of milk)

instructions.1: Fry the phyllo pastry in ghee or oil one sheet at a time, then set aside on paper towels.
instructions.2: Alternatively, place the cut phyllo in a baking tray and bake in the oven until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.3: Boil a little water and blanch the almonds; remove once the skins soften to peel them easily. Repeat with hazelnuts, then toast them.
instructions.4: Prepare a Pyrex dish, add the crumbled phyllo, and mix with the chopped almonds, hazelnuts, raisins, coconut, and a little cinnamon.
instructions.5: Boil the milk sweetened with sugar (approximately 3 tsp of sugar per cup of milk), then add the vanilla.
instructions.6: Pour the hot milk over the phyllo and place in the oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Spread the whipped cream or heavy cream on top, then place under the broiler briefly until golden brown.
instructions.8: It is best served warm.

instructions.1: Arrange the toast in a greased Pyrex dish.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs with the yogurt, sugar, and vanilla thoroughly.
instructions.3: Cook the fresh fruit, such as pears or apples, in a pan with butter, sugar, and a little cinnamon.
instructions.4: Pour half of the mixture over the toast, followed by the cooked fruit.
instructions.5: Add another layer of toast and pour the remaining mixture over the top.
instructions.6: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.

instructions.1: Slice the oranges and sprinkle them with powdered sugar.
instructions.2: Prepare a baking tray greased with a little butter, then arrange the sugar-dusted orange slices side by side in the tray; you may also sprinkle coconut or nuts over the oranges.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs, sugar, vanilla, and lemon zest together, then pour the mixture over the oranges and top with butter.
instructions.4: Bake in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
instructions.5: Once cooled, garnish with chantilly cream, placing fruit such as strawberries or pineapple in the center of the cream, and surround with pistachios, crushed nuts, or according to your preference.

instructions.1: Sort the lentils and wash them several times.
instructions.2: Chop the onion and garlic and place them in a pot with the lentils; cover with water or broth, then simmer over low heat until cooked, adding more liquid as needed.
instructions.3: Once cooled, blend the mixture in a blender and then pass it through a sieve until it reaches a somewhat thick consistency.
instructions.4: Return the mixture to the pot and season with salt and cumin, adding the tablespoon of soaked rice; leave over low heat until the rice is cooked through, then remove from heat.
instructions.5: Heat the ghee or oil and fry the finely chopped onion until golden, then stir it into the lentils, mix well, and serve in bowls.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs thoroughly with the sugar until the mixture thickens, then add the vanilla.
instructions.2: Gradually fold in the flour and baking powder into the whisked egg and sugar mixture gently until the flour is fully incorporated.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into a greased round cake pan and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.4: This cake is used to make various types of layered cakes and tortes.

instructions.1: Parboil the medium-sized cubed potatoes.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the small onions, whether whole or sliced.
instructions.3: Prepare a tomato sauce seasoned with salt, cumin, cinnamon, vinegar or lemon juice, and the minced garlic, mixing well.
instructions.4: Pour the potatoes into the mixture, stir, cover, and leave over low heat until cooked through.

bk13-6.name: baking powder or yeast
bk13-6.standardAmount: 1 tsp baking powder or 2 tsp yeast

bk13-7.name: pizza toppings (mozzarella cheese, Kiri cheese, white cheese, olives, halal luncheon meat, tuna, minced meat mixture, shakshuka, minced chicken, tomatoes, green peppers)

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast in a little warm water and a little sugar, and let it sit to proof for 15 minutes.
instructions.2: Rub the flour with the oil, then add the yogurt and mix well; add the yeast and knead thoroughly until the dough becomes soft, adding water as needed.
instructions.3: Leave the dough to rise in a warm place for about one hour.
instructions.4: Grease a baking tray with oil and lightly dust it with flour to prevent the dough from sticking.
instructions.5: Place the dough in the tray and spread it out evenly.
instructions.6: Spread sauce over the pizza dough, then decorate as desired with any of the following: mozzarella cheese slices, Kiri cheese spread with white cheese, olive pieces, luncheon meat, tuna, minced meat mixture (osag), shakshuka, minced chicken, tomato slices, and green peppers.
instructions.7: Bake in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

fah-183.title: Mumbar Stuffing (Herbed Rice Filling)
fah-183.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-183.culturalNotes: Stuffed mumbar can be kept in the fridge until needed. Frying the mumbar in hot oil just before serving gives a better aroma and taste.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: finely chop the onions, herbs and tomatoes.
instructions.2: Place the onions in a bowl and toss them with the spices (salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice, cinnamon, sugar).
instructions.3: Add the chopped tomatoes and herbs and mix everything well.
instructions.4: Add the tomato paste and mix once more.
instructions.5: Wash and drain the rice, then add it to the filling with half a cup of oil and mix well.
instructions.6: Prepare the mumbar: soak the casings in warm water with vinegar and baking soda for half an hour.
instructions.7: Peel and clean the mumbar well, then soak it in flour and coarse salt for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Stuff the mumbar with the filling and close both ends firmly.
instructions.9: Cooking the mumbar: place water in a pot over the heat with the bay leaf, mastic pearl, mastic, salt and pepper.
instructions.10: Add the stuffed mumbar to the boiling water and leave it for an hour to an hour and a quarter.
instructions.11: Remove the mumbar from the pot and serve with parsley, salt and pepper to taste.

fah-184.title: Grape Leaves Tagine with Meat (Waraq Enab)
fah-184.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-184.culturalNotes: Make sure the grape leaves are soft and light in colour, and arrange them correctly in the tagine so they don't come undone. You can add potato slices for a heartier dish.

fah-184-i6.name: Spices (salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, seven-spice, pinch of sugar)

instructions.1: Choose soft, light-coloured grape leaves, remove the stems, wash them and stack them in the same direction.
instructions.2: Place the grape leaves in a small pot over the heat with salt, cumin and two tablespoons of oil; blanch briefly and turn them.
instructions.3: In a bowl, mix the rice, tomato sauce, herbs, chopped onion and spices.
instructions.4: In a pot over the heat, add a garlic clove and a bay leaf, then add the meat cut into small cubes and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add the cardamom, turmeric, salt and sugar, then cover and leave to cook.
instructions.6: Fill the grape leaves with the meat and rice mixture, then arrange them in the tagine.
instructions.7: Add tomato, onion and potato slices, herbs and garlic, then place the remaining grape leaves on top.
instructions.8: Add hot broth, pomegranate molasses and lemon juice, then shake the pot well.
instructions.9: Cover the tagine with a plate so the leaves don't come undone, then leave over low heat until cooked through.
instructions.10: Prepare a yogurt salad with cucumber, mint, salt and oil to serve alongside.

fah-185.title: Budget-Friendly Kibbeh (Economical Kubba)
fah-185.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-185.culturalNotes: The kibbeh can be frozen after shaping; chill them in the fridge for half an hour first. When frying, make sure the oil is properly hot so they don't absorb grease.

instructions.1: Grind the bulgur until fine.
instructions.2: Add 3 cups of boiling water to the ground bulgur, stir, cover and leave for an hour to an hour and a quarter.
instructions.3: Prepare the filling: in another bowl, place the minced meat, the chopped onion, salt, black pepper and seven-spice, and mix.
instructions.4: Heat a tablespoon of ghee in a pan, add the chopped onion and stir until golden, then add the meat and stir until cooked.
instructions.5: Add the salt and spices to the meat and stir well.
instructions.6: Toast the nuts in a teaspoon of oil until golden, then add them to the filling.
instructions.7: Once the bulgur has cooled, add the flour, dried mint, black pepper, seven-spice, chopped onion, salt and oil, and knead until the dough is smooth and not sticky.
